preregistration.operator: Parent reviewed source, protocol and provider-free gates; --freeze --reviewed

privacy.redaction_boundary: All prompts, provider receipts, databases, IDs, account fingerprint, auth expiry and host paths are withheld-private pending exact-byte review; key contents are never persisted; actual charges stay unknown.

comparison.comparator: A: Astra typed helper (DecisionHandoffTool); B: direct jev-1.13.0 helper; Astra root, reflection and final verification

environment.initial_state_ref: inbox fixture evals/benchmarks/fixtures/decision-handoff-inbox.json at the pinned revision
environment.reset_strategy: Fresh public-network agent container and separate no-network verifier per trial; paired concurrent slot (all arms launched together, next slot only after every arm is cleaned up); no operator workspace mount; root 180s/6 rounds, agent 210s, setup 600s, verifier 30s, watchdog 930s, cleanup 120s; panel and E2E never overlap; account fp anonymous-account-02 shared with a user-approved video session (external usage unknown).

execution.command_redacted: Paired-slot dispatcher: every arm of a slot launched together from cells/e2e-slots.jsonl, next slot after all arms are cleaned up, Harbor 0.22.0 task bundles with frozen payload digests; Codex file auth and the TypeSafe key are loaded at run time and never printed

harness.name: Harbor
harness.source: harbor==0.22.0; paired-slot dispatcher sha256 16b3034ee781d504989f25fbcf71c2b40eec82a4e4da48fd69ca73215a215a2a; private runner.py sha256 cf73d37fd92850c28e6710be0471970f94993df3151eea08d3f31ac68854876f

study.analysis_plan: Admission only: one author-visible inbox-admission case, two items, two paired A/B arms, one repetition. Denominator 2. Validate source, isolation, observations and independent verifier reward; report helper intent/target correctness, fallback, wrong/extra reads and false completion. Review both ATIF-derived admission casts before U6b. Replay has no scoring authority. No natural-cohort pooling; no fitting or threshold selection.
study.decision_rule: Admission only. U6b is frozen only after both cells pass and the user reviews both casts (playback-check.json).
study.hypothesis: Both cells pass source, isolation, observation, independent reward and replay admission.
study.invalidation_rule: Judgment-output invalid is a semantic failure of a valid trial and keeps the trial in its denominator. Infrastructure invalid (transport failure, route drift, missing or contradictory usage, observation-check failure, incomplete export) is validity=invalid, outcome=unknown with a failure class; the first such cell stops dispatch, it stays selected and the primary is reported as not measurable. There is no replacement. A Jev failure followed by an LLM decision never counts as Jev acceptance.

primary_metric.aggregation: verified admitted Harbor cells / 2 (inbox-admission A|B paired slot)
primary_metric.name: intent_admission_success

study.research_gap: Earlier cohorts used label-only verdicts, three authored tasks and serial arms; calibration, reliability and load-matched comparison were not measured.
study.research_question: Does the re-pinned intent Harbor runner admit both helper arms in one paired concurrent slot?
